messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - Dedicated pool 'sageworks-dedpool-1' node node-87 reported repeated NVML thermal events and ECC spikes. 85% of capacity degraded. Auto-eviction triggered for low-priority tenants. Pager -> oncall

maya (oncall): I'm on it. Paging infra (samir) and runtime (ivan). marking high-priority customer = SageWorks.

samir (infra): looking now. nvml logs show: `GPU 0: temperature shutdown imminent` + AER ECC counts increasing. Host is reporting PCIe AER on gpu2. grabbing dmesg.

ivan (eng-runtime): Noted. Which tenants are running on node-87? Need to know live job risk (long GPT batches).

opsbot: tenants on node-87: [sageworks-app1, sageworks-embedder, batch-analytics-42, internal-test-job]. Policy: isolate enterprise tenants before mass eviction.

june (support): flagging support ticket RED-12345 to SageWorks with initial note: "We are investigating a GPU node issue in your dedicated pool. Some in-flight requests may be delayed as we move traffic. Will update within 30m."

maya (oncall): Plan: 1) mark node-87 unsched. 2) isolate enterprise tenants (sageworks-*) to avoid bulk evict affecting them. 3) attempt graceful live migrate for long-running jobs. 4) drain remaining and evict. 5) hardware replace if still failing. Anyone disagree? :thumbsup:

samir (infra): Agreed. I'll cordon node and attempt controlled drain. Running command: ``dedpoolctl cordon node-87 --pool sageworks-dedpool-1``

ivan (eng-runtime): For live jobs, use `jobctl migrate --job-id <id> --prefer-host host-22` for compatible hosts. Check model compatibility (same model weights). I'll query cache sticky-keys to rehydrate on target.

maya (oncall): samir, please list running job ids on node-87. I'll pick the top two to try migrate.

samir (infra): jobs: 0x7a3 (sageworks-embedder), 0x9ff (sageworks-app1-inference), 0x12b (batch-analytics-42). 0x9ff is a low-latency production route - we should avoid hard evict if migrate fails.

ivan (eng-runtime): I'll attempt migrate for 0x9ff and 0x7a3 now. Command: ``jobctl migrate --job-id 0x9ff --target-host host-22 --preserve-kvcache``. Pasting logs: ``migrate: started -> warming target KV cache (0/3 shards)``

samir (infra): drain command for node: ``dedpoolctl drain-node --pool sageworks-dedpool-1 --node node-87 --evict-nonenterprise --reason "thermal-ecc-spike"``. Running now.

ivan (eng-runtime): migrate 0x9ff status: warming complete, handoff OK, redirecting traffic. 0x7a3 migrate failed with persistent CUDA context error (nvml reports GPU reset during memcpy). Will fall back to checkpoint-and-restart on another host.

maya (oncall): june, pls update SageWorks: short note that we are migrating their production route to alternate host; some short tail latency possible. ETA for full pool replacement ~90-120m.

june (support): updated ticket RED-12345 -> message sent. Customer responded: "App OK but seeing sporadic 503s for the embedder endpoint". Asking for an ETA.

samir (infra): node-87 now cordoned + most non-enterprise tenants evicted. Checked BMC: IPMI shows fan ramp but PSU sensors spiked earlier. Kicking off hardware-ops replacement ticket HW-785.

opsbot: HW ticket HW-785 created and assigned to data-center team. ETA 70m.

ivan (eng-runtime): When we evict the batch job 0x12b, ensure its model checkpoint is left in persistent storage; jobctl checkpoint --job-id 0x12b --path s3://redwood-checkpoints/0x12b-pre-evict.

samir (infra): done. Checkpoint uploaded. Evicting 0x12b.

maya (oncall): status check: production route (0x9ff) migrated, embedder (0x7a3) restarted on host-24 from checkpoint, some 503s persisted but within SLA slack. Which tenant still shows errors?

june (support): SageWorks reports embedder 503s cleared, but they observed increased tail latency on inference. They requested a post-incident runbook.

ivan (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation: throttle large-batch requests on migrated hosts and enable prefix caching for embedder to reduce KV cache warm misses. Patching route: `routingctl set-policy sageworks-embedder --prefer host-22,host-24 --max-batch 8`

samir (infra): NVML on node-87 still shows AER increments despite cordon; good to remove from pool. Marking node-87 as quarantined: ``dedpoolctl quarantine node-87 --pool sageworks-dedpool-1 --until-replaced``

maya (oncall): Good. opsbot, can you trigger fallback policy for any remaining sessions that try node-87?

opsbot: Fallbacks enabled: requests will route to dedicated spare hosts in pool and then to burstpool-alpha if needed.

ivan (eng-runtime): Note: KV cache keys for sageworks-embedder were preserved during migrate for 0x9ff; we will run an integrity check: `kvcheck --prefix sageworks/embedder --verify` -> all keys present.

june (support): Customer update posted: "We've been migrated off problematic node. Some latency observed but service remains up. Rep will await replacement notes."

samir (infra): Hardware ops confirms on-site engineer en route, replacing suspected faulty GPU thermal assembly. ETA revised to 60m.

maya (oncall): Current status: mitigation successful, customer impact limited to short tail latency and transient 503s for one embedder job. Node quarantined. HW replacement in progress. Creating incident page: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/2765432100|incident-2765432100>. Please add timeline notes.

ivan (eng-runtime): Quick action items I/O: 1) add KV warm-up pre-pop for enterprise tenants when migrating across hosts, 2) add retry/backoff for prefix cache misses, 3) evaluate lowering thermal eviction threshold for older host types.

maya (oncall): Agreed. I'll hand off to samir for hardware follow-through and to eli for follow-up SLO monitoring. I'll go clear page in 60m unless further alerts. :white_check_mark:

eli (sre): I'll watch latency graphs and set a temporary alert for embedder tail p99 > 1.5s. Will post if it spikes.

samir (infra): HW ops updated: node-87 GPU replaced, initial burn-in looks stable, no ECC increments observed in last 5m. Will run full stress test before reintegrating.

maya (oncall): Once stress test passes, we'll join change window to re-add node to pool as 'reintegrate-no-evict' then gradually allow scheduling.

june (support): Customer acknowledged and closing immediate support loop; they'll await full postmortem.

opsbot: Incident state -> mitigated. Incident TTL: 7 days for postmortem and action items.

eli (sre): p99 steady at 420ms for embedder, no more 503s.

maya (oncall): Final summary for thread: root cause = GPU thermal assembly degradation leading to ECC/PCIe AER; impact = short-lived evictions/migrations for enterprise SageWorks tenants with transient 503s and elevated tail latency; mitigation = node quarantine, live job migration + checkpoint restarts, hardware replacement. Next steps = postmortem, runbook edits, lower thermal thresholds for host-family-x.

maya (oncall): closing page, will publish full timeline and follow-up JIRA tickets (RUN-921: runbook updates, INFRA-1442: lower thresholds, HW-785 closure).
